item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00055","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C21","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C18 provides a compact two-paragraph administrative pattern closely matching the child: paragraph 1 assigns a statutory function to a designated official or agency, and paragraph 2 requires another department or agency to furnish requested support for carrying out that paragraph-1 responsibility. The child adapts the same sequence by delegating the critical-area determination to the Director of Defense Mobilization and then requiring the Commissioner of Education to furnish requested information. C21 and C15 contain similar information-furnishing provisions, but these occur within much broader administrative schemes and do not match the child's concise two-step structure as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby delegated to the Director of Defense Mobilization ... the authority vested in the President ... to determine areas which are critical areas by reason of national-defense activities.","parent_excerpt":"the Displaced Persons Commission is hereby designated as the agency which shall ... make or prepare the investigations and written reports required by section 10 of the Displaced Persons Act of 1948","explanation":"Both begin by assigning a specifically identified statutory responsibility to a designated executive official or agency."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commissioner of Education shall furnish the Director of Defense Mobilization ... such information as may be requested ... concerning measures taken to provide school facilities ... pursuant to paragraph 1 of this order","parent_excerpt":"The Department of State, the Department of the Army, and such other agencies of the Government as the Displaced Persons Commission may request, shall ... furnish the Commission such assistance as it may need in carrying out its responsibilities under paragraph 1 of this order.","explanation":"Both follow the initial assignment with a second paragraph compelling other governmental bodies to furnish requested support for the paragraph-1 function."}]}
